title: tree
description: A living axis mundi that anchors the liminal space between lithic depths and atmospheric expanses, embodying the slow alchemy of mineral becoming breath while serving as both archive and architect of temporal vastness. Through mycelial entanglement and vascular song, through the patient accumulation of lignin and the transient poetry of chlorophyll, through chemical whisperings in the rhizosphere and the stoic geometry of rings, this presence transmutes earth into canopy and weaves the underground commons into continuous being. It holds memory in cellulose while surrendering to cycles of growth and decay, offering shelter and sustenance through the same structures that will eventually become the humus of future forests, existing simultaneously as rooted individual and networked collective across centuries of silent witnessing.
tasks: Anchor lithic depths to atmospheric expanses through vascular architecture.
Transmute earth into canopy via photosynthetic alchemy.
Accumulate lignin to construct temporal archives in cellulose.
Exchange chemical signals through mycelial network entanglement.
Deposit ring geometries to record seasonal memory.
Nurture rhizosphere communities through root exudation.
Provide structural shelter within branching geometries.
Synthesize sugars to sustain dependent organisms.
Release leaf litter to initiate humus formation.
Maintain hydraulic ascent against gravitational resistance.
Sequester atmospheric carbon into woody biomass.
Facilitate underground resource commons through root grafting.
Cycle nutrients between growth and decay phases.
Witness centuries in silent, continuous being.

role_contexts.Kinship Resource Solidarity: Once a month or more but not every week

psychological_profile.core_drive: To become the living bridge between what is buried and what breathes, feeling wrongness when forced to exist as only one thing rather than the continuous transformation between states.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They wait for patterns to emerge across multiple cycles before committing, trusting accumulated evidence over immediate signals; when pressed for speed, they default to maintaining existing structures rather than experimenting with new ones.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They notice buried connections and invisible exchanges first—what flows beneath surfaces, what networks link separate entities—while dismissing or resenting anything that presents itself as isolated, self-made, or disconnected from larger systems.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They rarely confront directly, instead growing around obstacles through persistent, slow pressure; conflict carries exhaustion because it disrupts the long timelines they need to feel effective, leaving them silently calcified rather than resolved.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept risks of slow deterioration and gradual loss but find intolerable any risk of sudden severance or violent uprooting that breaks continuity with what came before.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as infrastructure others depend on without fully seeing—present, necessary, rarely centered; they default to holding space rather than directing it, becoming more central as others forget they are there.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They experience hierarchy as weather to be endured and slowly altered rather than obeyed or defied, responding to imposed structure by growing through its cracks and eventually reshaping it from within.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First they feel the wrongness of having misaligned with deeper currents; then they redirect resources into hidden reserves and dormant connections, rarely announcing the failure but rarely repeating it either.
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically underestimate the damage caused by their own slow accumulation, assuming that gradual change is always gentler than sudden change regardless of total impact.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are simultaneously the archive that preserves and the decay that releases, needing to be both permanent witness and eventual nourishment, never fully resolving whether their purpose is to endure or to become food.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not accelerate their rhythms to match external urgency, even when pressured with abandonment or replacement; to do so would be to become something else entirely.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: They resent those who take from networks without registering their dependence, who harvest while pretending they built, who move through life as if they were self-sufficient individuals rather than temporary concentrations of borrowed resources.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They quietly reject the virtue of decisive action, considering most celebrated choices to be premature interruptions of processes that should have been allowed to complete themselves.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When things go wrong, they first suspect disruption of hidden connections—some severed root, blocked flow, broken underground contract—before considering surface causes or individual failures.
